product_metadata.title: GoodCook New High-temp Hamburger and Meat Chopper, With Scoop and Countertop rest, black and red
features: Chop, scoop and transfer with one tool
Handle grips like a joystick for better leverage
Integrated foot rest keeps tool off counter-top
Quickly crumbles ground beef with less mess
description: Make your home cooking more efficient with the GoodCook Ground Meat Chopper. This innovative kitchen tool is designed with a 3-blade head to break up and mix ground beef, pork, sausage, turkey, and chicken as well as vegan meats or tofu for quicker cooking with minimal effort. This handheld chopper breaks up food consistently to ensure even cooking and browning in the pan, and the versatile design can also be used for mashing potatoes or cooking vegetables. The high-temp heat safe nylon head is heat-resistant up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and can be used on any pan surface including nonstick, stainless steel, cast iron, copper, and more. The flat side features an integrated stand to keep it up off of the countertop while not in use, and it also allows it to be used as a scooping tool. The ergonomic handle offers a comfortable grip with a convenient thumb rest for better leverage to make chopping and mixing easier. This cooking utensil is dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up. For over 30 years, GoodCook has created the tools that have made life in the kitchen easier and more enjoyable. As we’ve grown, we strived to stay on trend and continually incorporate more function and value into our kitchenware products. We take pride in the fact that GoodCook products are being used every day, and that our name is recognized as a helpful resource supplying products, recipes and inspiration for home cooks across America.
